title_as_printed: Experimental values of water mole fraction, x(H2O), temperature T, pressure P and molar volume V on the liquid-gas phase equilibrium surface of the binary water-nitrogen system. Data up to x(H2O) = 0.900 obtained with the "synthetic" method. Data for x(H2O) = 0.930 and more obtained with the "analytic" method
pressure_note: total pressure at the liquid-gas phase boundary (PTx surface); basis not otherwise stated

value.what: water mole fraction: overall filling composition (synthetic rows, corrected for dead volume) or measured liquid-phase composition (analytic rows)

value2.what: molar volume of the mixture at the phase boundary point (synthetic rows only; - for analytic rows)

conversion_needs: V given as m3/mol after scale 1e-6; printed '-' means not determined
notes: No label rows. CSV rows 0-54 (55 rows, x(H2O) 0.134-0.900) are synthetic-method break points (isochoric P-T curve kink = bubble or dew point, overall composition, phase not specified in the table); rows 55-97 (43 rows, x(H2O) 0.930-0.990) are analytic-method liquid-phase samples at the stated T and P, so x(N2 in liquid) = 1 - x(H2O) (a solubility). Rows with printed '-' have no molar volume. Printed value 31 .O on 0.970/633 read as 31.0.
